release_notes: New stream filter URL Parameter (Keitaro parity): match any parameter of the click link by name, with exact case-insensitive values, * wildcards and an Empty option — the TikTok moderation setup (xxx=__PLACEMENT__ + Empty to the white page) now works as written. The stream-card chevron actually collapses a stream now. The campaign editor fits tablets and laptops: two panes from 1280px, tabs wrap into view, stream cards wrap instead of crushing the weight field. Panel-wide, layout (display, fluid width, margin, flex) moved into Tailwind's base layer, so layout classes in the markup finally take effect while the look stays centrally defined. The Report screen is a rounded card and "Report:" lost its colon in every language.
